import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 3, figsize=(15, 10))
fig.suptitle('Titanic Dataset Visualization', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Class
survival_by_class = df.groupby('pclass')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 0].bar(survival_by_class.index, survival_by_class.values, color=['gold', 'silver', 'brown'])
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class')
axes[0, 0].set_xticks([1, 2, 3])
axes[0, 0].set_ylim([0, 1])

# 2. Survival Rate by Sex
survival_by_sex = df.groupby('sex')['survived'].mean()
axes[0, 1].bar(survival_by_sex.index, survival_by_sex.values, color=['lightcoral', 'lightblue'])
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Sex')
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[0, 1].set_title('Survival Rate by Sex')
axes[0, 1].set_ylim([0, 1])

# 3. Age Distribution by Survival
df_age = df.dropna(subset=['age'])
axes[0, 2].hist([df_age[df_age['survived']==1]['age'], 
                 df_age[df_age['survived']==0]['age']], 
                bins=15, label=['Survived', 'Not Survived'], 
                color=['green', 'red'], alpha=0.6)
axes[0, 2].set_xlabel('Age')
axes[0, 2].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[0, 2].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival')
axes[0, 2].legend()

# 4. Fare Distribution by Class
df_fare = df.dropna(subset=['fare'])
for pclass in [1, 2, 3]:
    class_data = df_fare[df_fare['pclass'] == pclass]['fare']
    axes[1, 0].hist(class_data, bins=20, alpha=0.5, label=f'Class {pclass}')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Fare')
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Frequency')
axes[1, 0].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class')
axes[1, 0].legend()
axes[1, 0].set_xlim([0, 300])

# 5. Survival Count by Embarkation Port
survival_embark = df.groupby(['embarked', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_embark.plot(kind='bar', stacked=True, ax=axes[1, 1], 
                     color=['red', 'green'], alpha=0.7)
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Embarkation Port')
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Count')
axes[1, 1].set_title('Survival by Embarkation Port')
axes[1, 1].legend(['Not Survived', 'Survived'])
axes[1, 1].set_xticklabels(axes[1, 1].get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)

# 6. Family Size vs Survival
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch']
family_survival = df.groupby('family_size')['survived'].agg(['mean', 'count'])
axes[1, 2].scatter(family_survival.index, family_survival['mean'], 
                   s=family_survival['count']*20, alpha=0.6, color='purple')
axes[1, 2].set_xlabel('Family Size (Siblings/Spouse + Parents/Children)')
axes[1, 2].set_ylabel('Survival Rate')
axes[1, 2].set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size')
axes[1, 2].set_ylim([0, 1])
axes[1, 2].grid(alpha=0.3)

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
